Latin Capital Letter C With Cedilla Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Latin Capital Letter C With Cedilla is 128. Hold Alt, type 128 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Latin Capital Letter C With Cedilla also has the Unicode codepoint U+00C7, so you can type it with Alt+199 on Windows, search for U+00C7 in macOS's Character Viewer, use Ç in HTML, or \00C7 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Latin Capital Letter C With Cedilla character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity Ç for Latin Capital Letter C With Cedilla, but the numeric form Ç is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type latin capital letter c with cedilla on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 2 8 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Latin Capital Letter C With Cedilla character (Ç) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type latin capital letter c with cedilla on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Latin Capital Letter C With Cedilla. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Latin Capital Letter C With Cedilla" and click the character to insert it.

How to use latin capital letter c with cedilla in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00C7"; ()
  • Python: \u00C7 or chr(0xC7)
  • JavaScript: \u00C7 or String.fromCodePoint(0xC7)
  • JSON: "\u00C7"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Latin Capital Letter C With Cedilla?

The legacy Alt code for Latin Capital Letter C With Cedilla is 128. Hold Alt, type 1 2 8 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type Ç without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as Ç, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+199 not work?

Alt+199 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Latin Capital Letter C With Cedilla?

The Unicode codepoint for Latin Capital Letter C With Cedilla is U+00C7. You can use this value in HTML as Ç, in CSS as \00C7, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type Ç on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+00C7, then click it.
